Modified Incom A-24 Sleuth 

The sleuth is a highly maneuverable scout ship with excellent sublight speed. 
Despite being older than more popular scout ship models, the sleuth became 
Mol Hedron's choice for spying on the fledgling New Republic. Most of the 
time, the New Republic never even knew he was there. On the rare occasion 
when they did discover his presence, he was able to complete transmission 
and jump away.
